name: save-boot-10a-party-stats-menu-slot0
description: #130: party slot 0's HP, max HP, MP and max MP in g_ActiveCharacters equal the author-chosen values of harness/saves/disc1-md1stin-stats.json (party Cloud, Barret, Tifa; record 0: HP 271/314, MP 41/54, limit 100; materia slots empty). Load as save-boot-1-load does, open the field menu with Triangle (as save-boot-4), then check each value with equals (1/0 only), and the record's limit bar in the savemap. match: a rerun from the title snapshot ends in the same state.
